response: deferred to the owner: an acceptance change (whether pik_printed should accept a pik_rate equal to the printed coupon on loans printed "S + m % PIK" whose whole coupon is paid in kind) is the owner's decision. Nothing implemented in the rule; the 54 printed-coupon pik_rate corrections stay (precedent D-218 Commonwealth, Silver Capital) and the 12 pik_printed findings stay outstanding with proposal PD-pik_printed-1885968-4 under the existing reason pik-printed-rule-reads-margin-of-whole-coupon-pik-loan. Orchestrator recommendation (a): accept a pik_rate equal to the printed coupon where the PIK figure follows a benchmark code and par growth matches the coupon. If the owner rules (b) instead, the 54 corrections are withdrawn. AMENDED: owner ruled 2026-10-25 (D-232): "accept both recommendations, (b) for HPS and (a) for T Series", scope all three funds proposing the reason. Implemented as a repair of pik_printed (commit d7df345, D-235) because a rule_problem cannot be an accepted disposition; ledger re-run on rftsc clears the 11 whole-coupon quarters. Continental Battery 2025-09-30 (no benchmark printed) stays outstanding under PD-pik_printed-1885968-5 for a separate ruling.
statement: pik_printed_not_published (identity/pik_printed): where the printed PIK figure follows a benchmark code ('S + 6.25 % PIK') and the row prints a coupon with no cash part, accept a published pik_rate equal to the printed coupon (whole coupon in kind), as the rule already accepts '100 % PIK'. The rule's own docstring notes this shape as a likely false alarm.
